text: UPDATE: I placed an order via DoorDash tonight. My Dasher has been waiting an HOUR for my order, it was supposed to be ready shortly after she showed up. All I ordered was pizza fries, a Coke, garlic knots and a cannoli. How difficult is that?  The Dasher ended up losing out on other orders/$ having to wait to long for mine. That isn't right. I won't order from Enzo's again, and I have been a regular customer.  Poor service is unacceptable.

So sadly I am giving this place 1 star because I can't give zero. I came here twice on Jan 30 2021 and both experiences were terrible. First 1 it took 15 minutes before I had to go up to someone in the bar area for my order. The second time I went straight to the bar area to get my order and the girl at the bar ignored me. I had to get her attention to get my order once again. After that I asked if they had to go bags and she looked at me like I was a bother. Then I asked if they had Parmesan cheese or pepper to go with my order and she tossed them in the bag and walked away. I couldn't even ask for napkins next sad that I'm complaining about the bare minimum. Place says they are hiring yet lots of people working it looked like. I was at the door waiting to even be greeted yet there was two girls wiping and cleaning off a table. Usually as a Yelp advocate I like to give a business 3 chances before I give out a bad review but two different visits with terrible snooty service kind of says it all.

Great service and fast too! I figured a Friday night at 6pm would be super busy with slow service, but I got right in and my waitress was excellent. All the food I ordered came quickly, everything was super hot (and correct), and I was in and out faster than expected. Good food as always too!

I'm a big fan of New Delhi. Between me and my roommate, we probably order from here at least once a week via Grubhub. I have yet to eat in person or try the buffet, but am excited to do so when we are able to.

We always get the naan and either a Chicken Tikka masala, Mattar Paneer, or Malai kofta. We also love to get a side of the Tamarind Chutney (which is reasonably priced and lasts us a few weeks). I prefer the Mattar Paneer to the Malai Kofta, but they are all good options. 

The thing to look out for the most is the spice level. There have been a few times I've gone up to "Medium" since I pride myself on loving spice (and I'm Indian), but dang is Medium spicy. I always need to remind myself to stick to Mild or Mild+ for my orders going forward.

On the off chance that I have to call the restaurant to make a modification or ask a question, the staff is also generally helpful. My biggest testament to how solid of an option New Delhi is for Indian takeout is that my SO (who used to live in University City near the restaurant 5 years ago and ate there all the time), still enjoys that we order from them today even now that we are in Center City.

DO NOT GO HERE 

My husband and I came here on a Saturday night around 8pm and all the food looked awful. I asked if they had crab legs and they pointed to an empty container of whah looked like shells. Then the women's bathroom was shut down so they made me go to the men's bathroom, where it smelt awful of feces and there was even sewage on the walls and coming out of some of the toilets. 

This place needs to be checked out by the health department. Do not go here. We went to IHOP instead and it was much better.

I'm not really sure why they accept 10pm reservations when they close at 10.  Needless to say my fiancé booked at 10pm reservation. I checked us in while he parked.  10 minutes in to me sitting down I was rushed to order because the kitchen closes at 10!!  We couldn't try any appetizers (I dying to try the oysters) and no dessert. In the middle of us eating they turned the lights on as to say "get out"  I had the the duck pie and was left still feeling hungry so I had to go home to eat left overs that I already had in the refrigerator. 
DON'T ALLOW 10pm RESERVATIONS IF THE KITCHEN CLOSES AT 10!!! What a waste of an outfit.

Delicious, consistent, and affordable burgers right here. They use local ingredients and you can taste the freshness of every veggie that layers your burger. I love that they carry elk and bison too. This is my go to for a straight up no fuss classic cheeseburger. Yum yum
Love this place. Always consistent good food. And the wait staff is very well-trained. The carrot cake is amazing, even if you are not a carrot cake fan.

Great gay bar with fantastic drink specials. 
The drag queens are funny and the events can be a lot of fun. 
Bartenders are pretty nice and friendly. Great atmosphere.

It was a first time for my wife and I and we loved it. I love the tenderness of the barbecue and all the different sides were fantastic and the service was great and it was reasonably price we will be back

Our server was Nicole, she was kind of hard to track down sometimes. The food was alright, I definitely had high hopes for the impossible burger but it was a bit of a let down. We also got the brownie to go - comes with ice cream, nuts, chocolate drizzle and a red sauce.

I don't know the woman's name who owns this place but she was so mean to me when I pulled up on "her property" during her renovations. I made the wrong turn to pick up my hubby from the scooter place next door with both kids screaming in the car. I got out of my car for 10 seconds to hand over his keys then I came back with her taking pictures of my car. Put a chain to the lot so no one can enter! I like supporting local businesses but her unkindness has not been forgotten!

So maybe I'm not a good temple terrace resident but I DO NOT understand the hype about Stefanos.
TT residents RAVE about this place so my husband and I decided to check it out.


WHAT I LOVE
-HOLY PORTIONS OMG. The waitress brought out to me
A H U G E bowl of pasta. See, the thing about pasta is, when you portion it: you can only portion it for a little 38 day old baby or a small 3rd world country. There's no inbetween.. and Stefanos portions it for a 3rd world country..
My husband and I gasped about the size and our sweet waitress laughed and said "oh, you've never been here?" Lol. That indicates to me that portions are this large for most pastas.
-The meatballs were delish 
- Service was kind, quick, and respectful!

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW
- this is not a fancy place. It's more mom and pop-y. 
- the second table on the first row WOBBLES A TON. Too much for it not to be noticeable to the staff?
- my husband had a burger and frys and it was underwhelming..
- your entree for pasta gets free soup or salad and free pita or garlic bread. I chose "rice and beans soup" it wasn't good or gross.. but I didn't finish it.


The food was okay and while I did get a small soup, bread, and 9 days worth of pasta...I still don't really know if it was worth $13....honestly, I could make it at home. 
We probably won't be back and probably should have never came lol we were peer pressured into this place so we got what we deserved I guess:)

Patachou's original digs, this is a super trendy place to be seen breakfast/lunch  joint near the Meridian Kessler area. When possible, the food is locally sourced and fresh. There's an omelette of the day that comes with fruit and toast. (Get the cinnamon toast!) If you're not feeling like an omelette, there are plenty of other options on the menu. 

Serve yourself coffee and settle in for really great food. You can't go wrong.

The Oak Bar is a great, old-fashioned bar in the basement of The Hermitage Hotel.  If you want a classic and classy bar experience, The Oak Bar is the place to try.  Their old fashioned was perfect, and I loved that they serve pork rinds as on of the bar snacks that come with your drinks--so southern.

For Tennessee BBQ, Martin's BBQ is not so great to me. Tried it again tonight for the 2nd time. It's dry and isn't even tasty without dousing it with sauce. TN BBQ is even good without sauce on it. The beans are good. Slaw's okay...but you have to "doctor it up" with salt and pepper. Meat was like that too -- not seasoned enough.

I'm writing this because i saw some bad reviews but we decided to try it anyway.  I'm glad we did. We had such a lovely and kind server. She was also very informative of the area. The food was typical ihop food but the service was excellent. Takia (not sure the spelling) was our server and she was great. Sometimes grumpy people leave bad reviews so here's a good one.
They charge for salsa  decent food, small messy environment. The picadillo quesadilla is good.

The best thing about this place is the food.  The worst thing are the people who work there.  Begrudgingly sloshing your soup into a half filled cup of soup and with a smile-less face and a half assed, "i can't be bothered" smear of cream cheese that doesn't even cover the bagel... But the soup is delicious and it is worth it to endure the shotty customer service for overpriced but delicious soup.

Ordered via Yelp/grubhub. Ordered two large breakfast Cubans with bacon, eggs, and cheddar. When we picked up, they gave us the wrong order- we discovered after opening the boxes when we got back in the car. 

We went back inside, got the right order, and came out to the car to eat it. I opened the sandwich and discovered that they forgot to put cheese on both sandwiches. We could have gone back inside to let them fix but didn't want to wait for them to melt the cheese, and didn't want to throw cold cheese slices on top of it. Should have been right the first time.

The sandwich was just ok. Soft Cuban bread, scrambled egg, and three small slices of bacon.
The hash browns were pretty decent. Greasy and crispy. Overall, would not come back.

WOW!!! most amazing service i've EVER gotten here in tucson. best beer selection on university, and best BQQ!!!brandon was an amazing and friendly bartender and accommodated us to the max. 10/10 would recommend!

Upscale mexican food with a chef twist! My wife had crab enchiladas and I had fish and shrimp enchiladas.  Wow! She said it was the best ever! Fresh, creative and a great salsa bar as well. House Margaritas are a must.

Came through here the other night to grab some takeout. Food took a little while than expected due to a rush of business---Makes sense, 6pm on a Friday night. 

I got the pad Thai chicken and my friend had the beef fried rice. I was pretty, pretty, prettyyyy satisfied with the pad Thai, and my friend was blown away by the beef dish. 

The workers at Dao's are super friendly and hospitable. I will definitely eat here again!

Amazing spot. Somehow manages to feel cozy and open. 

I had the Pasta Cacio e Pepe. It was cheesy and delicious.

P F Chang's you missed it this evening!  We ate there my choice for our anniversary dinner. We ordered lettuce wraps as we always do. Our bowl had just enough mix for one wrap. The remainder was the air crunch stuff. We ask for another bowl but our meal Had made it to the table before it did. So we told them to take it back. We were told they had changed the recipe!!  Bottom line is we'll never order that again. You ruined a very good dish. You also took away our desire to visit you again anytime soon!  Thanks!  John

An old school spot with interesting grocery finds and a line out the door for the muffuletta sandwich, which is efficiently ready to go. It's pretty good, but I thought the bread was a bit dry and there was a bit too much of it. Travels well though. I took it to the airport with me and wasn't sad about that choice. I did appreciate how quickly the line moved.

The atmosphere at Answer cannot be beat. People of all ages seemed to be enjoying it, making it feel comfortable yet exciting to be there. The menu was a little intimidating and confusing due to how minimalist it is in explaining things, but once we got the hang of it it was almost kind of fun. We tried the crab, as well as two other small plates. Trying combinations that I would never normally think of was a real highlight. The salad with kale and squash was my favorite, possibly more so than my main entree. My burger was just okay, I felt like the bacon was too overwhelming and my medium burger was a little over cooked. Still good, but not great. My tequila drink was absolutely amazing--dangerously so. We ended our meal with the blondie served with ice cream, which I will dream about for forever. It was a great finish to the meal. Also huge shoutout to our waitress, who's name I unfortunately forget, she was so kind and really knew her stuff!

I've gone here with friends to smoke hookah. the prices are decent. if you're sitting outside you may need to get the attention of the staff to ensure coals are changed out when needed. it is byob, except during ramadan. You smoke a cigar outside, not inside though. the food I haven't really tried just because it's a hit or miss with what's available 
the fries were decent though. had some spice on it to elevate it

My pick for tonite's dinner!

We've never had the opportunity to dine here, so our first time, and take out.

I called in two chicken teriyaki dinners and the Komodo roll.

We arrived within the time of 30 min. and walked in. The sign allows two people at a time, and the orders were on tables arranged alphabetically.

The meal came to $39 with a $5.00 tip.

The miso soup was hot, and right amount of tofu and miso flavor. The meal was really good for the price.
Chicken was plenty and nicely prepared without pieces of fat or chunks.

The roll was very good and we liked how they had the unagi sauce in a container.

Can't wait to go back.

Updated: 5/2/20

Only 4 days ago, and here I am, again!

Ordered the teriyaki chicken bento boxes and a rock n roll..called in at 2 to be ready at 5pm.

We tried calling yesterday, but wasn't able to get thru..

Unfortunately, I ordered wrong because the bento box is a kids meal.. so we had to wait a few more minutes.. and that was my mistake..

So nice of them to accommodate us!!!

We love the rock n roll so far!

Until the next time!

AMAZING!!!  Literally, the Most. Amazing. Biscuits. EVER!!!!!  I've never tasted anything like them. Our first trip to Philadelphia and I would make it again just to eat here.  The bone-in filet was INCREDIBLE.  The sides were delicious and plentiful.  Dessert was fabulous.  The atmosphere was so nice, and the service was impeccable.  I wish I could rate Butcher and Singer a 10!!  We loved it!

Generic coffee house in a little shopping plaza. Free wifi and friendly staff. I got a cappuccino and a breakfast sandwich. The cappuccino was very good, but the breakfast sandwich was unimpressive. There was nothing wrong with the breakfast sandwich, but I could have easily made the exact same one myself. It came with some orange slices and a slice of pineapple on the side.

I was left a little disappointed by my experience at Bamboozle.  I wanted pho on a recent chilly night and placing an order for pickup on their website was effortless.  It was ready at the advised time and the restaurant was full, so I was glad I had chosen a to go order. 

As far as my pho goes, it was a decent portion but the broth lacked flavor despite all the addition of hoisin and sriracha.  The chicken was chunky and tough and the beef seemed to be a bit undercooked despite me choosing the cooked meat option.  Overall, I've had better pho at other places around the bay and their new competitor off Henderson would be my go to in the South Tampa area.

Solid BBQ. I got brisket plate with fries.
Minimal wait time to order, friendly and helpful cashiers, fast service, and attentive workers checked on us a couple times throughout the meal.
My family and I love this little diner. Friendly staff, yummy diner food and quick service. Highly recommend

Every time I come downtown for a lunch meeting, I always suggest this place. The poke bowls are delicious. The ordering is super easy and convenient. I always have enough to eat and plenty more for leftovers. The restaurant is great for casual meetings. Highly recommend!

My wife has picked up from Cole's twice.  The first experience was great.  Food was in an appropriate containers and presented with all accompanying items that we paid for!  Service was accommodating and interested.  Last night we repeated the same order only to have the food look like it was left overs and presented with little or no care.  Service seemed to be going through the motions and not customer focused.  We understand it was busy but it is better to turn away business than run business away.  As a long time restauranteur this should be known.  While we live only 3 blocks away this restaurant has lost us as customers.  Order at your own risk!

Love this spot! It has a little diner feel with a really amazing, seasonal, fresh menu. Friendly staff and such a great atmosphere! Where all the locals (now myself included) come for a great meal. Really looking forward to coming more for brunch :)
Sitting in the bar. It's Christmas Eve. They are busy, but seats are available in the bar. Love Dawsons!! Ron is the best! It is a place you can count on ALWAYS!

This cute joint has delicious vegan food.
They are known for their cakes, but don't miss their breakfast and lunch options.
I ordered the fried chicken salad, but replaced the chicken with cauliflower bites. The salad was good but it was a bit too much dressing. I added some more spring mix when I got back to my apartment.
I also got the fudge brownie as a treat to myself and it was very dense and moist.
Would highly recommend this place for a casual lunch.

The prices might be a little high in general. Maybe more discounts when packaged with 3,6,12,24. I mean with more discounts means I will come more often right... anyways their service is superb. They are polite and very knowledgeable and always very helpful and interactive. I feel like they are friends from walking in until I walk out. And now for their juices and smoothies. Their juices taste amazing. They are top quality ingredients you can feel. They even go about explaining juicing for those who don't know. They have tasters for the new people and numbers for a step by step basis. They also have Some rewards. The smoothies are very creamy and also very delicious. Nothing has sugar added which is great and just keeps the taste organic.

Now my next list of things to try are their açaí bowls and other nicknacks they have in there.  

I Recommend! I support and I will come back again.
Absolutely ridiculous. If this is what they consider a toasted steak and white cheddar sandwich then my god... waste of my money

Greenleaf Juicing was super refreshing! The açaí bowl was AMAZING! The team was knowledgeable on the entire menu & were open to adding additions to my bowl. The staff was very friendly, too. I would recommend Greenleaf as a healthy snack. If I could walk to Greenleaf from work, I would definitely frequent weekly! This is the perfect summer snack.

Great artisan food choices, hip atmosphere and friendly vendors. Long Chim Nola - Christy, one of the  artisan chefs serves up wonderful curry and salads. Empa Nola has a variety of Empanadas. Get a sampler platter of 3. I had the Latin American choices - yum! 
Very clean and quiet environment

Italian pastry heaven. Every visit to my hometown, this is a must stop. 

This location has an old school bakery atmosphere. Upon walking in, I was greeted by Nancy who was dressed in white bakers garb. Even though I knew what I wanted, I circled around the open display of various pastries. There were also an array of cakes and cookies in closed displays as well. 

I happily decided on some traditional cannolis and sfogliatelles! They were all neatly placed in boxes and tied with string. Nancy was also kind enough to let me try a pignoli and holy cow, they were the most delicious cookies I've had in a long time, maybe ever. She also asked if I was there alone, I told her my brother was with me and she handed him one to try as well. 

Though I wasn't there for long, Nancy was a great conversationalist. I thought this place was great, but she made the experience pleasantly greater. Price is reasonable. I walked out with 5 cannolis and 3 sfogliatelle for $40.

Worth adding that everything is delicious. I brought the cannolis back home to VA and everyone was very impressed. The filling was so smooth, creamy. I've had awful cannolis before where it was gritty or not sweet enough. Go to Termini Bros. Bakery and it will not disappoint.

This place was sort of in a sketchy part of town and parking is limited.  That's literally all that can be said negatively about this place.

The food was AMAZING.  Me and my fiancee got a dozen empanadas, all different ones.  They all blew us away.  Is it okay for food to taste this good?

Not a ton of seating but is okay for a group of like 2-4 people.

Delicious, will definitely be coming back!
Worst hibachi and sushi I have ever had. $50 for the worst food and part of the order was missing! DoorDash delivery was early and exceeded expectations.

We went here for brunch but I have also been in for BBQ crawl and a glass of wine so three separate occasions. The decor feels like they are trying too hard for what it actually is. The staff were equally snooty. When we went for brunch the host (maybe owner) visibly rolled her eyes when we asked to sit at a high top (why?). The food was bland and extremely expensive. I guess that's why they were the only restaurant without a wait for brunch on Saturday at noon.

Drive-thru is my only experience here, but each time it was quick and with upbeat, friendly staff. She even added an extra shot to my cold brew w cream when it came out too milky for my liking at no extra charge. I really enjoy their bacon, egg and cheese croissants too. The egg is actually really good-not too dry with a good amount of yolk. And the bacon is crispy.  I always have to get a donut here too (duh) and the chocolate old fashioned is by far my favorite. It's light and moist but has that chocolatey glazed crunch on top. Very fresh. I'm giving 4 stars because my plain cake donut was unfortunately stale. Not sure what happened there but it still had good flavor even if it did sit around too long.

If you are looking for a great daily breakfast spot head to miles table like I do most mornings. This place has amazing burgers that they have deals on Wednesday's for and great eggs sandwiches. If you love soups they also have great butternut squash, Tomato and sweet potatoes soups. This places had amazing fries that you must try with their homemade aioli. It is nicer nicer than fast causal but a spot you order first and then find your own seat and the waiters bring you food. Family friendly as well.

I got veggie burrito with spinach, quinoa, corn, beans, and pick de Gallo on whole wheat wrap. Very good and healthy. Wrap is soft and flavor is on point. I took a star down because I realized that according to the menu it comes with salad but I didn't get salad. I had mine to go. Also I tried to substitute spinach with romaine but I was told that I couldn't so I said to omit it. When o got my order there's spinach in it. 

My husband had shrimp tacos. He said it's good and the shrimp is huge. 

I was lucky to ask for flan and they had it. It's pretty good with enough sweetness and nice density. It comes with strawberries and blueberries.

AMAZING restaurant! Authentic, flavorful and DELICIOUS! I had the tasso shrimp and grits, and they did not disappoint! I highly recommend! They have outdoor and indoor seating, along with a small patio outside bar.

Wow! I was so excited about trying out Bar-B Cutie until TODAY!  I ordered a pulled pork baked potato  & they didn't  put the bbq sauce on it so it taste like dry meat & thick ass potato's. I called the restaurant to let them know what was going on .. never asked for my money back only to have the ONE baked potato made correctly ! I was on the clock and  on lunch breAk when I  went to get the food .. the "manager" told me to not eat the potato they would come to my job pick it up & replace it because that's "protocol" so I stopped eating waited for someone to come (who was very nice btw) but all she brought was bbq sauce and a damn fork. That was the most ghetto thing I've ever seen ..why would u make me stop eating  my food and have someone go out of their way to bring me 2 items  ! I never asked for my money back I just wanted to ENJOY THE DAMN POTATO I SPENT $8  on ! & not only that she told me she would remake it and I asked could I come once I got off because I can't keep clocking out to get food that was supposed to be made correctly! I went back to the restaurant nice as hell with my receipts and a good tone and the manager said "no I'm not making it & the boss said no" so not only was the food not  made right she made me stop eatiNg making the food cold ...thinking they were going to replace it .. I tried giving the driver the POTATO AND SHE SAID NO! & they refused to make ONE POTATO LIKE ITS FILET MIGNON with shrimp and crab legs ! I am really upset! I hate when comp

Come hungry! This is the perfect way to end your beach day with delicious food, live music on weekends, great music and even an ice cream shop near by. Food is fresh and delicious. Large portions. Perfect for kids and is all outdoor seating so great foe Covid.
Delivery was timely. Pizza was delicious!! Will definitely order again! Guy that took my order was generous, and you could hear the smile in his voice!

This place is a great place to eat in Apollo Beach. There's very few nice places to eat in Apollo Beach and this place is a nice change with good food and service. Nick I was awesome and the clams casino is the best.. The pizza is very close to the real deal. Just got back from Italy last week and the pizza is very very similar..
No in store dining. I asked manager why and was told they didn't have to since drive thru is so busy. Told her I don't eat in my car. She was unconcerned, so I left.
Highly recommend!! Food is absolutely outstanding!! It's fresh and very flavorful. The service is great with staff upbeat and friendly.

Tons of seating inside and outside with lots of fun bar games. The drinks are expensive but the beer comes in a massive tankard- take that into consideration when you order. It's a fun place to hang out and play games at.

Clayton is, perhaps, the nicest suburb of Saint Louis. The opening of The BAO, a couple of years ago, elevated the appeal of this suburban midwestern town for me. 

While the rice bowls make for a perfectly satisfying meal, the star items on the menu are the bao sandwiches. The pillowy buns, made with rice flour and milk powder, have a subtle sweetness that magnifies the flavors of the meats, especially the crispy and juicy fried chicken. The skinny fries are a perfect side item. 

To try an assortment of bao sandwiches, get a trio of bao sliders. Of course, there's no better way to end the meal than with a fried bao ice cream sandwich for dessert. 

If you drive to The BAO, there's a parking lot just behind the restaurant; there's an alley between the buildings to get to it.

I am new to Souderton but this restaurant was recommended by a few people so I decided to give it a try. I got lo mein and the noodles were amazing. It is not what you get from your average chinese restaurant. These noodles were homemade and really fresh. They almost tasted like thin dumpling dough. I have gotten the lo mein a few times but need to venture out and try a few other things on their menu, which I am sure will be just as great
Great selection !!! Very reasonable price 9.99, I will mark it for future reference and definitely come back again
Best sushi in town!!! Always friendly and always consistent in quality!  Always my sushi go to!
The place is cozy, the service excellent and it was the best food I had in my entire visit to Nashville.
Went here 3-4 days a week for years until I moved to the other side of town. It's the best deli in the city by far. I need to go back more Bronx bomber all the way

Wasn't sure what to think about delivery steak dinners and wasn't disappointed. I always order my steaks rare cuz without a doubt it'll be medium rare or medium and for once I actually got a perfectly rare steak. A little spicy but overall very happy

Horrible!!!! When I arrived I was told my order given to another customer and they were on the way back. I was reluctant to take the food that was given to the other customer but he came right back and it was still hot. Ok it gets worst SMH My shrimp rolls had no shrimp in them. I got 3 and not one of them had any. My Shrimp Lo Mein had not shrimp, but it did include hair. I called the store to let them know and I was put on hold so long that I just hung up. I was very disappointed because the food use to be good. I will never order from here again or recommend them. I really wanted to give them no stars but the person that took my order was very nice.

I am IN  LOVE with this awesome coffee shop primarily because they offer gluten free bagels for us celiacs. It has been YEARS since I've had a bagel with warm cream cheese, and that's exactly what My Favorite Muffin delivered to me today. I was able to grab an awesome window seat, enjoy my breakfast, and get work done in a cute, clean and poppin' atmosphere. I'm a fan, and have established this as my new office.

Wanted a dog. Haven't been here in many years. Read reviews  good. Some were not and mine is NOT The hotdog was pitiful tiny little thing no beans no cheese no boring no flavor.. The gentleman helping us was very nice soft-spoken. The tables were really nice very clean. I just didn't really feel like having a table "for lunch".
So that's my take on this place. Definitely will not go back
Sitting on the patio was divine - great social distancing and the food as good as ever.

Was looking for something different so decided to give this place a shot and was pleased.

I called ahead to order Chicken Tikka Masala, Tandoori Chicken, Vegetable Samosas and (plain) Naan for takeout; was told the food would be ready in 15 mins and it was... The restaurant is located on a main street (Marshall Road), in a very small shopping plaza with a parking lot so it was easy to locate and there is ample parking.

I was greeted at the door, upon entering the restaurant, which is very small. The guy who helped me was pleasant and professional... When I got home, the food was still hot and the flavor was on point. 

My only gripe is that I would prefer to have a little more variety offered with the meals. For example, the chicken tikka masala is just that with rice, I would like if the dish could be served with garbanzo beans and a veggie on the side - again, for variety... But in spite of it all, I will definitely return.

Great food, friendly atmosphere. Service was a little slow, but it gave us a great opportunity to sit and chat.

We took 3 teenage boys and 2 adults, order the 6 entree shared plate. It was SO MUCH food! I grossly underestimated the amount we would get, but that's on me. Everything tasted great! We'll go again, but only order the shared 4 plate next time. Delicious!

My brother and I came here yesterday late afternoon for the fried chicken Sunday dinner. It was my first time here and Matt, the Manager was extremely informative and knowledgeable about the mansion and its history giving us so much background! 

The food was perfectly cooked, flavored and served and the portions very generous and the staff very attentive to come by and check on us and top up our dishes (it is all you can eat served to table).

an amazing first experience, leaving me ready to return again soon!
Healthy dining at reasonable prices.  Good selection of gluten free items as well as vegetarian.  We'll be back

Service was great!  Although there was a wait, we were able to visit the stores close-by and our table was ready when promised. Food was meh. Beef filet was cooked to my liking however very tough and difficult to cut.  Salmon was very nicely spiced but a bit over cooked. From a service standpoint, they are very efficient always ready with water and drinks. Our server was very attentive and the staff does a great job of tag teaming.

Customer service was trash.
The tall girl is awful. The new owners need to get it together. It was never this bad as Tastees

Tried the cheese pizza with white sauce as a create your own. Wow!!
Super cold beer and then house dressing on the Decaros salad was just sweet enough!
We will be back!

Pretty bad. We were the only people in the drive through but it took forever. The cashier gave us a brownie to make up for the wait which was nice. The tenders were cold, bland, and dry. The three sauces it came with were not tasty. Definitely won't be going back.

Located next to the Saigon supermarket lies this little gem of a restaurant.
Don't expect the most courteous of services but instead take a seat and wait a minute for someone to come and give you a menu. Pick what you want and place your order. Do expect your food to arrive within 5 minutes from the moment you order. Expect some of the greatest tasting pho and banhmi sandwiches you could ever have. Expect the food to be delicious and the best bang for you buck.
5/5 would totally recommend to anyone that want something cheap and delicious Vietnamese food ever.

Now I think I have a fav location at Armature Works! Besides Dixie Dharma, this place tuna bowl was soo refreshing and delicious. The tuna was grilled perfectly with so much flavor and the brown rice was very tasteful. However, the veggies that were added to the bowl is what gave it that nice touch of crunch and flavor. I love a dish when you don't need any salt/pepper to enjoy. I also had their loaded tots. It was okay with me. For me, the tots were overcooked, almost chewy. I am not sure if I would order it again. 

My friend and chose to eat outside on their patio overlooking the Hillsborough River. We went during happy hour and as the sun was going down. The breeze was heavenly and the atmosphere was nice. 

Do yourself a favor and go to graze during happy hour or the evening to enjoy a nice drink and make sure you get the Tuna Bowl with Brown Rice. I am not sure if that was the name of it but if you tell them what you want they will definitely know what they are talking about.

I love the way that they ask for your cell number and call you when your order is ready. Good System!
The best Philly cheese and always consistently good! Hot, quality meat diced perfectly, good fresh bread!! You will not be disappointed! I won't eat Philly cheese from any other place!!

We just went this weekend - and sat outside. The food is GOOD. The service is...smug. And bad. (I asked for peppers to not be on my sandwich - I'm allergic - and yup - there they were all melted into the cheese - hard to fish out) It took a trip inside to see where our waters were after a long wait. We were STUNNED by how expensive it was - $63 for 2 sandwiches, a side order of fries, a chocolate croissant and a diet soda. (and the 20% service charge - gratuity?- built in) We've been there before and always found it a bit precious. (in a bad way) The waitress had told us they ONLY served locally-sourced juices and fruit...and didn't think it was funny when we lightheartedly pointed out that orange juice was on the menu. It's just too much money for meh service and good but not amazing food.

I could not have been more surprised. I expected  ok ribs & got THE BEST RIBS I'VE EVER EATEN!!!! I'm a Southie (Tampa), hell of a chef & I can be a bit persnickety on good food. I literally went into my phone contacts & deleted all other BBQ places!!! You guys rock!!

Love doesn't even really describe how much my family enjoys Blue Sushi Sake. The food here is absolutely delicious.  Staff is friendly. Come during Happy Hour (all day Sunday and some other times I am not 100% sure of when) the prices are really fair!
Best thing on the menu is the Cherry Bomb.  Trust me.  It's a piece of raw tuna on a bed of tempura rice.  So fabulous and everything about it from the sauce to the warm/cold juxtaposition just works so incredibly well.
The shishito peppers are another family favorite and they are drenched in a sauce that you think about for days after you eat them.  Don't let them take the bowl after you finish the peppers because you need to dip absolutely everything else you order in the luscious sauce.  You can thank me later.
I really love the amount of vegetarian and even Vegan sushi rolls they have.  I came with a friend who eats vegan and my eyes were really opened to how nice it is to have so many vegan options.  My favorite vegan roll is the Prince roll.  So good.
The atmosphere is fabulous as well.  It is perfect for a families, but also so much fun for a couples or girls night out on the weekends.

Not sure how this place has so many great reviews. The food was expensive, not fresh, and flavorless. The menu stated that the crab dish I ordered would come with poke sauce, and it was definitely BBQ sauce. Don't waste your money or time.
Huge slices! Love their fat boy pizza. Would recommend this place to anyone. Love that their outdoor patio is dog friendly.

Officially my top three cheesesteak in Philly. Jim's is one of the bigger steaks in the city and it's definitely one of, if not the best.

The line nearly always runs around the corner of the restaurant, but we were lucky and caught a slow hour. 

The steak is a bit expensive as it runs a little over $12 including tax, but entirely worth it. I split half of it with my mom and it was completely filling. Also if you're feeling frisky, you can get a Lorenzo's slice of pizza and make it a Philly sandwich.

Our last two meals have been underwhelming. The blackened mahi-mahi was overcooked, and  our salads didn't come out until after the entrees. Combine that with the failure of our server to provide any refills, and it was an overpriced and disappointing experience. I'm hoping the past quality and service returns. Overall, the menu is not bad. I suggest sticking with the sandwiches, which is really their sweet spot.

Part 2: The gyro is great!! I don't know how they made the "meat" or vegan feta but it's so delicious. Spot on, tastes just like a gyro/doner kebap. I will definitely get this again.

The faux chicken parm (Parm's The Way) was... fine. I'm not sure what I wanted different about it. Maybe in more of a sub roll with more marinara.

The brownie is maybe too unfloury.
I you want to eat real Puerto Rican food this is the place to eat. The decor is not the best but the food is good.

Super flavorful food, but not too spicy if you get the level 3 spice. I was happy with everything I got and the service was extremely fast. The only slight complaint is that if you order any protein on the side, it does not come seasoned at all. Avoid this if possible

OMG yummmmm!!!!

Jelly filled powdered donut holes are genius and so friggin delicious!!
best frozen chai lattes ever!! baristas are incredibly sweet and hard working :) new favorite coffee spot by far
This place is so delicious! I went two days in a row. I had the crab po boy with garlic Parmesan fries and the voodoo shrimp tacos with Cajun fries! The garlic Parmesan fries are AMAZING

About a year ago, I started a new job in the central ave area of St. Pete. I tried a bunch of different places in the area for my Friday lunches out, but once I found the Floribbean, I pretty much stopped going anywhere else! The food is incredibly flavorful and is always hot and fresh. I love the different flavors and styles and how they combine together. The portions are large and I can rarely finish a bowl in one sitting. I live in Tampa and can say that this is a truly unique restaurant. I highly recommend!!
Such a great experience! Fernando was our server and he was super attentive and helpful! The food and drinks were great and reasonably priced. The games are also so fun! Highly recommend

Not bad for a quick local establishment if you want a beer and some food. My rice was under cooked; but the mesquite cooking of the meat was pretty good.  Not a fan of the self serve chip & salsa bar. Update 9/3/19:  Tried a different Chuy's in Oro Valley for lunch. It was a better experience than the last one. The California Tacos were pretty legit. Also enjoyed the chips and Salsa bar more at this location. I'd definitely come back for happy-hour. Great easy going vibe.

What a great idea! Order as often as you like for one price on most items, without the waste of a buffet (eat it all or they will charge you extra). This place was really good. The food was fresh (made to order) and the servers are very attentive, so don't worry about having to wait long between orders. This place is busy, so you'll probably wait, not for long and it is worth the wait. When we're back in Tampa we will be back to Koizi for sure.

My wife and I ordered takeout this evening and were incredibly impressed! 

* Service was good and Marcus was extremely polite while taking our to-go order.

* Food was incredible. The Korean chicken wings were a meal in of themself, forcing me to to save half my "The Burger" for tomorrow. Given how delicious it was, this was a hard decision and exercise in self control. 

* My wife was giddy with the fettuccine nero pasta. It... didn't last long.

* Both the fries and Mexican corn were decadent. 

* We got the cookie and key line tart. I enjoyed the cookie, but it's eclipsed by the tart. This isn't a comment on the quality of the former, but deliciousness of the latter.

Summary? We've ordered a lot of takeout with COVID. This is the first time we felt like we had fine dining restaurant quality food.

Thank you for a wonderful experience!

Went here on a quest to find a decent Chili Cheeseburger based on a recommendation. Sadly, this place isn't it. The burger patties are not meaty (very odd texture).. more gelatinous than anything and the chili was disappointing. Fries were ok but that's about it. The outdoor seating area was not cleaned. Tabletops were left dirty. Off to the next place I guess.

I have eaten at this chain in NYC and at various HMart food courts. It never disappoints, and is one of my favorite go-to places for fried chicken. The chicken I got tonight was just not right. I don't know if the chicken went bad, the sauces were expired, or what it was....There was a noticeably foul taste that both my boyfriend and I noticed as we bit into and chewed the usually delicious and crispy chicken. I was hungry when I got my order, and after a few bites, couldn't bring myself to eat anymore as I was concerned it may lead to a stomachache later. 
I wonder if the slow traffic of this location compared to others I've been to is the reason the freshness is subpar. Makes sense if they don't see enough customers to turn their ingredients faster...

Never going back here again. This chicken is too pricey to gamble on quality.

Great Dining Experience! First our server Lisa was very knowledgeable of the menu and we went with her recommendation of the oyster shooters to start   And to say they were delicious isn't doing them justice.  For our entree we both went with the scallops Rockefeller and omg are they delicious. 

If your looking for a place with a gulf view, delicious food, and great service this place get 5 stars from me !!

It is the best!!! Love, love love!!! Tried everything and all good, not your typical sushi place and it is not but food is great!!! A FEW THINGS: WHEN BUSY MAYBE HIRE MORE WAITERS, but everything else is great!!!

I don't know how this place only has 3 stars. Their spicy lamb biryani is highly addictive. Throw in a cup of that white stuff and it's just god-like. Also that cheesy bread, I mean come on, who doesn't like cheesy bread? Definitely not a 3 star restaurant, I give it a well deserved 4 stars.

First off the restaurant is beautiful!! It has a dock so you can access the restaurant via boat. It has a large pool with outdoor restrooms. The service was spectacular. The food was rich in taste and just WOW. We had the island shrimp as the appetizer and We were extents IMPRESSED. I had the Mahi tacos and they were awesome too. My husband had the Reuben grouper and jt was just flawless as well. I will be dining here again !!!

Said they opened at 11 gate was closed, just want to find out what time he would open and he said keep out when gate is closed. I thought that was rude I should just drive by til he opens the gate. Went to Ted Peters

This place is absolutely disgusting. It's completely dirty abs nobody is following the covid protocol or the walking path they created. There was a line of about 20 minutes with one person working and the food was just sitting there. Def somewhere you go to get food poisoning

Wonderful!  Always great. Tried ordering online last night for carry out.  It worked fantastic.  My order was ready when promised.  The eggplant here is very flavorful.  It was put into my wrap with the glass noodles.  I usually do the spicy tofu, but the eggplant was so much more flavorful.  This dish really sang.  I can't wait for cooler weather so I can do the Tribe soup!!!  Lona's food is ALWAYS fresh and extremely delicious.  Dumpling appetizers are the bomb.  Great food, helpful service, and always a pleasure.

Conveniently located near Tropicana Dome in downtown St. Pete, complete with its own private parking lot, they are serving up some authentic BBQ in its smokey goodness!

Started with a few Apps
Brazilian Pineapple was served up just warm enough with a delicious sweet/cinnamon seasoning that gave it a unique flavor.
Cornbread Madeleines were tasty.  Only complaint is that there were too few.  Would love a double order for $10 as opposed to a single for $6.

Of the mains, the highlight by far was the beef rib.  Smoked to perfection, tender and sensational.  As it indicates, simply an enormous portion.
Sliced Pastrami was exceptional.  Hey, it's not Katz's but it had a great cure a tasty bark and a wonderful smoke flavor.  A winner.
Sliced brisket is very good.  Kept a good moisture with a nice smoke flavor and a tasty (not overbearing) peppery bark.
St. Louis ribs had just the right pull from the bone.  Good flavor, though a touch salty for my taste.
Pulled pork was not my favorite version.  A touch too dry and kind of lacking in flavor.  Maybe an off night for that cut.  Not so sure I'd order it again.

Sides
Fries were delicious, well-done double fried variety.  So many places the fries are but a throw-in.  These were delicioso!
Baked beans simply weren't my style.  These were more-or less a throw in.  Disappointing, as I really enjoy my baked beans.
Purple slaw was quite tasty.  A little sweet with a vinegar base which really helped cut through the bbq meat.  Great side.

Al

I have a high level of respect for restaurants like Lemon Tree that take a bit of a risk and put out a menu that is different than the common menus found at most sandwich places. 

My wife and I split two different sandwiches and we both agreed they were some of the best sandwiches we'd tasted. 

Lemon Tree does what great restaurants do... they created a unique menu that is full of tasty food. 

Instead of making 5 different types of good bread they perfected one type that goes with all their sandwiches. 

To top it off, the service was very polite. 

We recently moved to Boise and are happy to have a go-to sandwich shop in the beautiful downtown area.

We have been coming to the Sausage Shop for at least 6 years. Their sandwiches are always delicious and their stuffed pork chops are fantastic! We regurlarly buy their brats and burger patties as well and they are always flavorful. The staff are awesome, it's a little family owned shop and they're always kind, even when they're super busy! If you're lucky enough to time it out right, their Lent-time-only tuna sandwiches are awesome, we wait all year for them; all in all, we highly recommend this shop for all your sandwich/brat/meat/grilling needs!
First time in Santa Barbara, a bit of long wait but worth it! Food was AMAZING! I forgot to take picture of the carnitas nachos but they were also very good!

I really want to like this place more. The owners and employees are very sweet and trying to drum up business with being attentive and advertised. 

The food is what you would expect from the other reviews but just too bland. The sauces are more gelatin than taste, the fresh vegetables are near undercooked (honestly enjoy that part myself), the meat is not fatty and likely US standard beef. 

My companion enjoyed the Crab Rangoon and although the dumplings look the same I was assured by her the Rangoon was a better won ton. I pictured the explanation of a dumpling to come out much differently. Also, the apple pie could not rival many but was okay - even though served cold. 

Three stars are representing my own tastes. Service, willingness to continue to evolve (tucson foodie) and fried rice on the cheap are promising. This will hopefully get the honest comments to make this place even better and it is evident the owner is dedicated to make that so.

We dined on the table outside, and I'm not sure if we weren't supposed to but they served us just the same. This is the best fried chicken I have ever had. The chicken breast was so juicy I am replaying my first bite of it all the time. The staff is very loving and it shows in the way they took care of us. Would recommend 10/10 times to anyone coming to Nola.

I've been to Cafe du Monde and I like the beignet's here better. They have a crisp, golden exterior and a softer interior. I gave this only four stars though because the actual location is tight and is way too small for its prime bourbon street location. The line can get quite long and then you still wait for the food. Overall, you should stop and get a bag (or three) here but you may want to keep walking to enjoy your treats.

I stopped in here to grab a quick lunch! I got the gyoza and pad Thai. Both were absolutely delicious. The lunch portion is HUGE. Ended up getting multiple meals out of it. The gyoza was fresh and didn't taste overly fried which I appreciated. 

I haven't tried the sushi yet, but I'm looking forward to coming back here again soon :)

the food was really good. the waiter was a really nice man and was doing everything he could to satisfy me and my family's needs. I noticed when the waiter was coming out he got talked to in a very inappropriate manner by the manager. He seemed very unfriendly walking around and giving looks at other families that were dining at Dempsey's. He talked to other waiters and waitresses in or out a rude manner. I did not enjoy listening and being around that type of environment.
This spot is perfect after a trip to the casinos. The sauce is the perfect pairing with the BBQ pork.

Absolutely delicious pizza and a great beer selection. The atmosphere was very casual and family friendly and there's a good selection of menu items as well. This was our first visit and the wait was very long...waited over 30 mins for a small pepperoni and finally had to go ask where it was. Upon asking, was told, "it just came out", although they couldn't find the order ticket anywhere. Will likely go back, just hope the wait isn't this long every time!

Located on Merdian Street just inside the 465 loop in a strip center.  Clean, simple, modern space with polished concrete floors and open to the structure above ceiling.  Light wood, table tops, chairs, and accents on the stark white walls.

Moderately sized dining area with a mix of two top, four tops, and a large bar height community table. Unfortunately due to the size of the space you feel the weather outside everytime the door opens.

You order and pay at the counter and your food is nrpught out.to your table. 

Today I tried the Jasmine lychee tea with boba  at 100% sweetness.  The tea was great, the boba were slightly tough in the center and mine was not sweet at all. We also had the pan fried gyoza and they were so good, perfectly prepared and tasty! And for the main course spicy ramen with a slice of.pork shoulder. It was sooooooo good. Just slightly spicy giving It a tad bit of flavor!

In all it was super duper good. Perfect for a cold day.

One star.  Came for dinner/Stanley Cup playoff atmosphere. Place was not busy... at all. Great TV's. Food took forever. The wings tasted like something I could microwave at home. 
Great place for a happy hour patio visit. Not a nice place for dinner. Come here to drink, that is all.

We had a delicious brunch here yesterday. We came expecting a long wait for brunch since the weather was beautiful and it was a busy Sunday morning, and they told us it would be around 35-40 minutes to be seated. It really ended up only being 20 minutes before we got a table, which was a pleasant surprise! Just be sure you have your entire party there to be seated or they won't seat you. 

The food was really delicious and the outdoor setup is great. The tables were well spaced and they had hand sanitizer on every table. My only tiny complaint was that we felt a bit rushed -- we had four waiters in 5 minutes asking to take our plates -- but I understand that times are really tough for restaurants and they were eager to sit their long line of waiting customers. 

Overall, the food was fantastic and the outdoor ambience is top notch.

Scaled back menu...and portions. We have a family of five and we're not big eaters, but first time we've left with no take home boxes in a year or more of eating out weekly. Overall food was hot and appetizing. Service  was painfully slow however, as it took 30 min plus to get our order. Three hosts/hostesses just standing idle which was puzzling. I'd say there is much better value (and service) locally, I'd probably skip this place.  Just my 2 cents, your experience may differ.

It's like stepping back in time when customer service actually meant something.  The staff were super friendly and helpful.  All the food is homemade including all the breads.  I had the reuben and it was fantastic.
There's also grand piano in the dining room and they have someone playing which is cool.

Even for an overcast and chilly day, the Boathouse was the perfect spot to have lunch and catch up with an old friend. 

I had the whiskey lemonade, and although not complicated, it was refreshing and the perfect accompaniment to my meal. I had The Hill salad with grilled chicken, and don't tell the restaurants on The Hill, but this salad was better than any of them. The grilled chicken was good, but next time, I'll probably top my salad with shrimp. My friend and I split an order of fries, which were really good too. 

I love the ambiance of The Boathouse patio--it made me feel like I was in Central Park in an episode of Gossip Girl.

Went here on a whim, wife wanted tacos so we stopped in. Place was surprisingly empty given rush hour, though it is the week between Xmas and New Years, so maybe why. 

I had a steak burrito and my wife had three tacos; chicken, steak and pork. Food all around was perfect. Burrito was large enough that I couldn't quite eat the whole thing. 

I'm assuming the guys who met us at the door were the owners, but don't know. At any rate, both were very friendly and one went through the menus with us. Definitely will be back when on this side of town!

If you're looking for better tasting bbq, go to the location on Campbell. Went here as it was closer drive for me, but I was disappointed with the mediocre tasting meat. Even the sauce on the brisket couldn't save this sad bit of beef that was overpriced. (Don't get the hungry size because it's the same damn size as the smaller regular size. ) 
Customer service was bleh and my to go order sat on the counter for some time. No one called my name and I only got my food when one waitress who was probably wondering why I was still waiting while people who ordered after me had gotten their orders and left, checked for me. 
Never coming to this location again.
Went for a bachelorette party, the buffet was good and the drag queens were wonderful.

All I have to say is absolutely wonderful,I have been there many times ,but on Mother's Day and during the Coronavirus pandemic It was very hard to find a restaurant to order a meal,but I have to say Bocconcini really came through. When we picked up the food it was piping hot and delicious. What a wonderful meal to add to a wonderful Mother's Day. Thanks to the the chef and wonderful staff for a great experience,can't wait to order again.
Best Asian restaurant I've ever eaten in in PA hands down. Very fresh nice staff every ingredient was perfect.

Amazing experience!! Family run and operated, this restaurant goes above and beyond to satisfy their customers.  The sushi was the best I have ever had.  Absolutely have to try the volcano and the spicy tuna rolls.  The ambiance is perfect from anything to a special date to a night out with the girls.  Live music Thursday through Saturday and the most beautiful outdoor patio with fountains and great lighting to enjoy a nice Tampa evening.  Staff are amazing and so friendly.  Our favorite restaurant in Tampa!!
I love Mexican food 24/7 and I'd come here for every meal ever! Their chips & dip are my absolute favorite and the fajitas and quesadillas are to die for. Amazing!

Got takeout from here for the fourth or fifth time during quarantine. This time we got the kansai special, yellowtail scallion and spider roll. The sashimi were large generous cuts with firm texture. Nothing tasted fishy that shouldn't have. I could do without the shrimp tempura roll in the kansai special and would much rather have the rainbow roll that comes with the platter for 2. Takeout orders come with a generous amount of soy sauce, wasabi and ginger.

Ordered on their website for asap pickup. The only confusing thing here is they don't provide you a pickup time with your confirmation. Looking at their pickup times I decided 30 minutes sounded about right and my order was ready when I arrived but I never got any signal my order was ready by email or text.
Stop what you are doing right now and get a Detroit pie from here today!!  Seriously one of my top five favorite pizzas of all time.

I could name about 4 pizza places in town that are so sooo yummy- and this is not one of them. The pizza is so bland. You would think a meat lovers pizza would be popping with flavor.... i tasted the pepperoni and the overly sweet red sauce and thats about it. Disappointed, it was kind of gross.... shouldve gone to Noble Pie

We have been to this restaurant on two occasions.  We have found the food to be very good; however the service proved to be very poor during both visits.   

We understand that the location is new and very busy; however it would seem to be of common sense to supply patrons with items such as utensils,  plates, napkins before and/or at least with the meal service.  Our waitress would piece meal on silverware service one at a time, and seemed bothered when we asked for everyone to get what they needed.  She was quick to find excuse (almost to the point of being argumentative), and not so quick on resolution.  

It is sad to see this establishment's great food overshadowed by extremely poor service.  Yes, they can get by with that now, but at some point the newness will wear off and people will grow tired of the lack of service.  I am just hopeful that the management team gets the ship righted before we see another location fail.

In fairness  there are probably a lot of good staff on site; and subsequently we may of had the misfortune of getting two that weren't.

Nailed it. 

I asked for the sandwich seen in the picture with no mustard and I got meat, cheese and bread...

This joint is a fundamentally sound Italian restaurant!  These days we order delivery through an app rather then being a woo girl in a closed environment during a pandemic.  Obviously everyone knows certain things do not travel well and disappointment should be expected. Boy was I surprised at how well these dishes stood up to the rigors of steam and time whilst traveling.  Plus there was a down tree en route that clearly threw our delivery driver down a rabbit hole.  Set us back an additional 10mins, I was certain dinner was ruined. It wasn't, it was tremendous!
I'm a bit of a "MEDIGON" when it comes to ordering Italian and have to get the chicken parmigiana as a basis to start my evaluation. It was fantastic!  Also painted up the menu with salads, apps, and pasta primavera.  Everything was spot on.  Also this arrancini type of thing called supploni al telefono was quite nice.  Overall wonderful experience and better than any comparable Italian restaurants in the area.  As a disclaimer I've never dined in, hopefully the overall restaurant experience is consistent with the food they're laying down.

Ok so there really is a " war " if who makes it better. Popeyes it Chick-fil-A. And the winner is?... Popeyes for me!!!!!! I grew up in Montreal and I now live in a very quiet area in the South Shore. So when my little sister who is a cop tells me to be careful because people actually get into fights to get this sandwich, I take her words for it. Drive-thru it is. The wait was long. The wait was so worth it. I ordered for myself only, one classic fried chicken sandwich and one spicy chicken sandwich with some fries. Drove back to my parents house and had both sandwiches lol!!! I am now team Popeyes classic fried chicken sandwich!

Great pizza and nachos. Happy hour $5 Italian nachos!
Pizza was half and half Wise Guy and the Enforcer! Great food! Best pizza we had in a a while! A most stop in Downtown Boise. Brandon W. Was a great server with a lot of knowledge on the food and great advice.
One of the best sushi in town for sure. Service is great, don't forget to bring your own Sake

It was ok but definitely not great. We did order for Grub Hub to pick up so there is that.  The sushi was decent but not as fresh as I had hoped it would be. I love yellow tail sushimi and was not as fresh as I like it. I actually gave it to someone else. I gave 4 stars because it is in the pandemic time and no one is really running in all cylinders  right now.  If I was eating grub hub right now they would get a 1 star. The first driver bailed because it took to long to make the food and the second driver got the food 39 mins after it was made. Plus add the delivery time to hotel and it was 44 mins after being made. I will never order from grub hub again. 
Be safe Yelpers and Yelp on.

Their stromboli is some of the best I've ever had. Highly recommend it.  I'm also happy to report they have pretty good burgers, cheesesteaks and french onion soup.  Never actually had their pizza, but I've heard good things about it. Prices are reasonable for a pub, service is prompt, and the place is huge so seating has never been an issue for me. All and  all, Via Marconi's Pizza Pub is probably one of the best places in the Kulpsville/Hatboro area.

Great atmosphere with a perfect size for social distancing. My table ordered the Pompano fish, the Fire-toasted chicken and the Native loaded chili and the key lime stack and Naviera Espresso Chocolate swirl for dessert. While I have to admit all good was very flavorful, the Pompano fish and the espresso ice cream were my favourite. I strongly suggest you get these two a try when you visit Ulele. Also try making reservations ahead of time, otherwise you'll end up waiting for approx. 1hr or so.

The drinks were ok, nothing crazy. I had the piña con fuego and it was average and so was the Springside Smash. I'd suggest getting something else other than cocktails. For this reason I'd give it a 4.5 star if I could. I believe the drinks take a big part of the whole dinning experience. 

If visiting this place, try going after sunset and sit outside. The outdoor patio just gives you a whole different experience that you will definitely enjoy!

Food itself isn't bad, just wouldn't necessarily choose here over any of the many other "Mexican" spots in town. Nachos are pretty cool in that they're huge and spread out such that the topping to chip ratio is nicely baked on. Not particularly flavorful, but pretty hearty portion, which it should be, given the price. 

I do really like the tres leches cake and the passion fruit sorbet. Would be nice if they had a selection of frozen margaritas :)

Service is consistently poor, and after my third visit, it's the real reason I won't be returning. Our waitress was pretty inattentive (I know they're busy, but wasn't possible to flag her down for water, etc, and took so long to order), and several other staff members were oddly rude in dropping off food. Pretty bizarre. A one off I can write off, but third strike with multiple different employees ranging from ignoring patrons to being pretty condescending (one refill of a water glass shouldn't be a big ask, right?), is too much.

I dream about Goldie's tahina shake on a weekly basis. So simple yet uniquely delicious, the cup is cute and all around it's the perfect sweet treat.

Mediterranean food is typically not my favorite, but I loveeed Goldie. The falafel were crispy and light, without that oily heaviness that falafel can sometimes have. Go with the harissa sauce and add shawarma fries!!

During COVID times they have an online system set up for you to place your order ahead of time or you can also order in person. There's always been a line when I've went, but it goes pretty quickly.

Good food. Very nice server. Wife and I both did the hibachi dinners. Chicken and shrimp. I had the steak and shrimp. Started with an order of steamed shrimp shumai. All prepared in the kitchen. No actual hibachi show. BYOB. Reasonably priced.

Richie did a very good job serving us this evening, in spite of having to deal with some issues with some other guests. He came over and apologized and explained what happened, and then gave us a free slice of cheesecake to take home! Just the fact that he took the time to explain things to us really saved what could have turned out to be a bad evening. Instead, we had a very pleasant dining experience, and the food, as always was tasty and enough. We will definitely be back.

Came here for Happy Hour on a Friday night and sat at the bar. Prices during happy hour are great and the food was delicious! We tried a bunch of things: Korean BBQ beef, edamame dumplings, Kobe sliders, pork and chicken bao buns, brussel sprouts, and the fried rice. All of it was delicious but my favorites were the beef and pork bao buns.

Service was a little slow but the place was packed and it was a Fri night so that was understandable. I would definitely come back for HH and would recommend to anyone looking for yummy asian fusion at a great pricepoint!

Drop Dead Gorgeous bar. I really enjoyed the atmosphere and the food is good. The drinks are fun and not too serious. The hotel next door is beautiful and there is also a super cute ice cream parlor next door called Sundae Best.
